metadata.topic: How to turn an idea into a clear weekly plan

slides.title: Your plan is not too ambitious. It is too vague.
slides.subtitle: Turn a scattered idea into a week you can actually execute.
slides.bridge_to_slide_3: Start by giving the work a finish line.

items.title: Specific
items.body: Describe what will exist by Friday.

items.title: Visible
items.body: Make it easy to tell whether it is done.

items.title: Useful
items.body: Connect it to a real result, not busywork.

items.title: Small
items.body: Keep it inside one focused week.
